title: Bidirectional Markov Text Analyzer
launchLabel: Open the Bidirectional Markov Text Analyzer lab
pitch: Build a language model from your own corpus, then watch another text light up token-by-token by how surprising it is. Forward and backward order-n Markov models are merged into a single surprise heatmap, with click-to-replace predictions, add-k smoothing, backoff, and live perplexity.
